aboutRights: Sounds from MyInstants remain the property of their owners. StikSound runs 100% locally with no external dependencies. The exported video is at most 5 or 10 seconds, chosen with the button on the audio bar (10 by default).
exportSuccessVideo: Video downloaded. WhatsApp does not import it as a sticker. On some Android beta accounts you can try Create sticker and pick this video from the gallery; WhatsApp decides the duration and audio. That beta is not officially documented.

exportSuccessBundle: Bundle saved. Note: it contains image and sound as separate files; WhatsApp may treat the image as a normal sticker.

whatsappHelpBtn: 📱 How to use it on WhatsApp
whatsappHelpTitle: How to use it on WhatsApp
whatsappHelpSteps:
Use the 5s button: WhatsApp video stickers keep only about 5 seconds of sound.
Tap ⬇ and download the "MP4 video".
Move the MP4 to your phone's gallery. Android: it lands in Downloads (the Gallery app shows it). iPhone: in Share, tap "Save Video" so it goes to Photos. On a PC: the file is in Downloads; move it to your phone (cable, Google Drive or by sending it to yourself) and save it to the gallery.
In WhatsApp for Android, open a chat, tap the emoji icon 😊, go to the stickers tab and tap "Create" (or +).
Pick the video from the gallery, adjust the crop and send it. The sound sticker shows a speaker icon 🔊; tap it to play.
whatsappHelpNote: Making sound stickers from a video is still a gradual WhatsApp rollout (Android beta) and button names may change. If you don't see the option, send the MP4 as a normal video. WhatsApp decides the final duration and audio.
